name: Privileged Communication with Identifiable Parties
description:
Composite rule: triggers when BOTH a privilege/confidentiality marker AND a case caption or docket number appear in the same content. This combination conclusively identifies privileged attorney-client material that contains an identifiable matter. Per ABA Formal Opinion 512, this content must not be submitted to any AI system.

Composite logic: Triggers when privilege marker AND (case caption OR docket number) are both detected in the same content
Compliance notes: This rule detects a high-risk combination: privilege/work-product marker + matter-identifying information. Identifier redaction alone does not clear this material for external AI submission — litigation strategy, settlement posture, and attorney mental impressions may remain. ABA Formal Opinion 512 requires lawyers to evaluate confidentiality duties, client consent/authorization, provider safeguards, and risk of disclosure before using GenAI with client-related material. RuleSentry blocks external AI submission; an attorney must perform the privilege/confidentiality review.

effect.message: Matter-identifying information detected (case caption or docket number)
